title: CPF Module Schema: azure-prdsvc-terraform-virtualnetworkgateway
description: JSON schema for CPF module 'cpf-azure-prdsvc-virtualnetworkgateway'. Use this to generate Terraform code that calls the CPF module.

address_prefixes.description: (Optional) A list of address blocks reserved for virtual network.

app_id.description: (Required) A descriptive name (abbreviation) for the workload (application) as it is registered in Leanix. The identifier format in Leanix is 'APP-12345', for the purpose of naming resources only 5 number will be used.

bgp_settings.type: map(object({ asn = number peer_weight = number peering_addresses = map(object({ ip_configuration_name = string apipa_addresses = list(string) })) }))
bgp_settings.description: (Optional) A bgp_settings block as defined below. map(object ({ asn = (Required) The Autonomous System Number (ASN) to use as part of the BGP. peer_weight = (Required) The weight added to routes which have been learned through BGP peering. Valid values can be between 0 and 100. peering_addresses = (Optional) A list of peering addresses as defined below. map(object({ ip_configuration_name = (Required) The name of the IP configuration of this Virtual Network Gateway. In case there are multiple ip_configuration blocks defined, this property is required to specify. apipa_addresses = (Required) A list of Azure custom APIPA addresses assigned to the BGP peer of the Virtual Network Gateway. })) }))

context.description: (Optional) Application context information for the resource(s) (max 10 chars).

default_local_network_gateway_id.description: (Optional) The ID of the local network gateway through which outbound Internet traffic from the virtual network in which the gateway is created will be routed (forced tunnelling).

edge_zone.description: (Optional) Specifies the Edge Zone within the Azure Region where this Virtual Network Gateway should exist.

enable_bgp.description: (Optional) BGP (Border Gateway Protocol) will be enabled for this Virtual Network Gateway.

environment.description: (Required) The environment where the resource is deployed. Given as abbreviation to leave more characters to the other naming components (max 3 chars).

generation.description: (Optional) The Generation of the Virtual Network gateway.

instance.description: (Optional) Instance number, if context includes/requires multiple resources of the same type (max 3 int).

ip_configurations.type: map(object({ subnet_id = string public_ip_address_id = string private_ip_address_allocation = string }))
ip_configurations.description: (Required) One, two or three ip_configuration blocks as defined below. An active-standby gateway requires exactly one ip_configuration block, an active-active gateway requires exactly two ip_configuration blocks whereas an active-active zone redundant gateway with P2S configuration requires exactly three ip_configuration blocks. map(object ({ subnet_id = (Required) The ID of the gateway subnet of a virtual network in which the virtual network gateway will be created. public_ip_address_id = (Required) The ID of the public IP address to associate with the Virtual Network Gateway. private_ip_address_allocation = (Required) Defines how the private IP address of the gateways virtual interface is assigned. Valid options are Static or Dynamic. Defaults to Dynamic. }))

private_ip_address_enabled.description: (Required) Should private IP be enabled on this gateway for connections.

resource_group_name.description: (Required) Name of the Resource Group in which to create the resource.

sku.description: (Required) Configuration of the size and capacity of the virtual network gateway.

tags.description: (Optional) Tags to be set on each resource.

type.description: (Required) The type of the Virtual Network Gateway.

vpn_type.description: (Optional) The routing type of the Virtual Network Gateway.

id.description: The resource ID of the Virtual Network gateway.

ip_configuration_pip.description: The Id of the public ip.

lng_id.description: The id of the Local network gateway.

name.description: The name of the Virtual Network gateway.

type.description: The type of the Virtual Network gateway.

agent_instructions.summary: To provision 'Virtualnetworkgateway' via Terraform, call this CPF module with the inputs defined below. Required inputs have no default and must be provided.
agent_instructions.module_type_notes: This is a single-service CPF module. It provisions one Azure resource type.
agent_instructions.naming_convention: Resource names are auto-generated by the module using app_id, environment, and region.
